findings.failureBoundary: completed Job -> Workspace Report source/action eligibility
findings.rootCauseDirection: A fresh current Plan 0.2 trajectory Job completed all three registered tools and persisted artifacts, but the projected Workspace was classified as source-not-current for M5 Report actions.

The real phonon upload persisted a Profile containing only the structure resource semantic while the canonical phonon goal required phonon capability facts, causing INTENT_PROFILE_CAPABILITY_MISSING before Plan/Job.
